recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: radiation-hardened chips rewriting what spacecraft can compute in deep space
small AI models finally small enough to run anywhere
television squeezeback graphics rebuilt cell by cell in CSS
collapsed Himalayan glacier sending floodwater through Nepal and Tibet
late-summer clarity over the bay, wind barely stirring

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Carve melt channels through a cracking glacier before floodwater reaches a hillside village — one screen, one rescue attempt.
composer-2.5-fast.touch_control: drag to etch trenches through ice
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: watch water reroute in real time and see if the village stays dry before the 45-second chunk collapses
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: crack lines spread across the glacier face and water volume doubles every 10 seconds
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: topographic watercolor, blue-white ice bleeding into ochre hills

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Deploy thumb-sized agent sprites from your phone — each completes one micro-task before expiring; chain them to ship a feature before sunrise.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.touch_control: tap to deploy an agent, hold to link the next instruction
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: feature bar fills as agents loop home; nail a clean ship before the sunrise timer hits zero
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: parallel tasks multiply and poorly timed agents collide and cancel each other
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: neon terminal pixels on dark glass, iOS shortcut widget scale

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Pilot a deep-space probe under harsh chip constraints — toggle between low-power drift and high-power bursts to slingshot past debris fields toward the next waypoint.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.touch_control: swipe to change lane, tap to flip power mode
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: reach the waypoint with charge to spare; each near-miss feels like cheating physics
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: micrometeor density thickens and power drain accelerates in shadow zones
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: phosphor green wireframe HUD over slow parallax starfield

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Rebuild a live TV lower-third on the beat — snap graphic blocks into CSS grid cells as a broadcast director calls layout changes mid-segment.
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: tap on beat to place graphic tiles into open grid slots
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: land three perfect squeezeback transitions before the commercial break sting
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: grid columns multiply, tempo accelerates, rogue WebVTT captions overlap your layout
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: retro broadcast serif colliding with monospace devtools, faint scanline overlay
